lines: I may have work when I trust you more.
I might have something for you once I know you better.
Come back when I have a little more reason to trust you.
I keep that sort of work for people I trust.
There may be work later, once you have earned more trust here.
I am not ready to hand you that responsibility yet.
Help the village a bit more, and I may have work for you.
When I know I can rely on you, I may have a task.
Build some trust with me first, then ask again.
I may open that work to you when you have proven yourself here.
Let us handle a few smaller matters before I give you this one.
The job is sensitive, and I do not know you well enough yet.
Show me that you keep your word, then we can talk about work.
People here still watch you closely. Give them a reason to relax.
I need to see how you treat this village before I involve you.
Earn a good name around here and I will reconsider.
This task goes to someone I know will come back.
Do right by a few people here, and they may vouch for you.
I cannot risk this on a stranger, even one who means well.
Give me time to learn what kind of person you are.

Check my badge next time. If it says {level}, we can begin.

Finish the earlier matter first, then ask me again.
One thing at a time. We should settle the previous work first.
I may have more once the earlier job is done.
That can wait until the current chain of work is settled.
Come back after the earlier work is finished.
I need the previous matter closed before I offer this.
We should not open that work until the earlier task is handled.
Settle what came before, and I may have more for you.

I need a little time to make the arrangements safely.
